tokens.name: bg-default
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebars, AI message bubbles, quiet panels.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Neutral badges, chips, muted fills.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for Secondary/Ghost buttons and menu rows.

tokens.name: bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of Secondary and Ghost buttons and tappable rows.

tokens.name: bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill; pair with text-disabled.

tokens.name: bg-strong
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off, neutral swipe actions, sheet handles. Holds 3:1 against bg-default and bg-subtle (it marks a control).

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and inverse surfaces; text-inverse on it.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, drawers and sheets.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, user chat bubbles. text-on-brand on it.

tokens.name: bg-brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of bg-brand.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of selected controls: checked checkbox and radio, toggle on, slider and progress fill. Holds 3:1 against bg-default in both themes; icons on it use icon-on-brand.

tokens.name: bg-brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Brand badge, selected menu row, avatar initials.

tokens.name: bg-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success badge background; text-success on it.

tokens.name: bg-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning badge background; text-warning on it.

tokens.name: bg-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons. text-on-brand on it.

tokens.name: bg-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of bg-danger.

tokens.name: bg-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Danger badge background; text-danger on it.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg-default, bg-subtle, bg-muted.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, captions, helper text on bg-default and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholders on bg-default and bg-subtle. Not on bg-muted (4.3:1).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels on bg-disabled. Not for readable content.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-brand and bg-danger.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, selected tab/menu text, brand badge text.

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Success text on bg-success-subtle.

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text on bg-warning-subtle.

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Error messages and danger badge text.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Decorative separation only: card outlines, dividers, table rules. Below 3:1 by design; never the only cue that something is a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, Secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 against bg-default and bg-subtle in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input border; pair with the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Selected tab underline, brand outlines.

tokens.name: border-danger
tokens.usage: Input in error state.

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control borders.

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: Default icon color.

tokens.name: icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Icons inside inputs, close buttons, chevrons.

tokens.name: icon-on-brand
tokens.usage: Icons on bg-brand.

tokens.name: icon-brand
tokens.usage: Brand-colored icons, the sparkle mark.

styles.name: heading-h3
styles.usage: Subsections, modal titles on large dialogs.

styles.name: heading-h4
styles.usage: Card titles, modal titles, app header.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: UI text, chat messages, inputs, descriptions.

styles.name: label-xsmall
styles.usage: Bottom nav labels, citation numbers, keyboard keys, count badges. The smallest text in the system.

tokens.name: space-none
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Toggle knob inset, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap, icon-to-text in tight rows.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, menu padding, small button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Small button & input horizontal padding, chat avatar gap.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Medium button padding, card gap, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card & modal padding, gap between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Section padding, conversation top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Page-level spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, selects, badges, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, chat bubbles, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and action sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggle tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Toggle knob, subtle lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Elevated cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, modals.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive control: a 2px gap in the page color, then a solid 2px indigo ring (4.5:1 on white, 6:1 on dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring-inset
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus for full-bleed rows and tabs where an outer ring would be clipped (list items, bottom nav, conversation rows).

size.note: Fixed sizes for touch layouts. Every tappable target on a touch screen is at least size-touch.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on touch screens (buttons, list rows, icons in bars).

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Mobile list row height with one line of text.

tokens.name: size-row-2
tokens.usage: Mobile list row height with title and subtitle.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile top app bar height.

tokens.name: size-bottom-nav
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button.
